messages:
maria: Quick sync — SOC2 sprint: need confirmation on who owns final audit-log schema sign-off. Current mapping I sketched: Eng-Platform = ingestion, Eng-ML = HSM key-wrap tests, Security = attestation + evidence. Can owners confirm?

raj: I can own ingestion sign-off. Status: PR #842 in review, needs e2e for gzipped events and retention flag.

alex: HSM wrap tests blocked on HSM emulator creds from infra. I pinged infra yesterday (no reply yet). If creds don’t land we can run mock-hsm for basic flows.

jen: I own the attestation checklist. I’ll finish the draft by EOD Friday. Need the exact evidence IDs to reference — can whoever generates ingest events add those IDs to the schema?

sam: Runbook link posted: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/hsm-attestation — added to the shared doc. @raj fyi retention policy change may affect downstream storage lifecycle.

raj: Good catch @sam — I’ll add a retention flag to the PR and ping Storage. PR is https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/842 for reference.

maria: Timeline goal: end-to-end smoke in staging by Tue (4760060000) so fieldwork/QA can run next week. Are we aligned on that target?

alex: Tue is optimistic — emulator creds ETA Mon AM per infra PM. If creds delayed, we fallback to mock-hsm for functional tests and delay attestation evidence until emulator arrives.

jen: mock-hsm ok for validating flows, but attestation evidence needs the emulator to produce signed blobs we can include in the evidence package.

devops-bot: deploy scheduled: "audit-ingest-staging" cluster deploy window 4760045000 -> 4760048000, rollback window 15m. Notified @@eng-platform and @@eng-infra.

maria: Action items (short): 1) raj — add retention flag + ping Storage (PR link above); 2) alex — confirm emulator creds Mon AM or fallback plan; 3) jen — finish attestation checklist by EOD Fri and list evidence IDs; 4) sam — attach runbook to PR and call out lifecycle change. Please ack and paste any PRs/design links here.

raj: ack. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/842 — added retention flag, cc @storage-team in description.

alex: ack. Will post update here once infra confirms creds (ETA Mon AM). If not, will note mock-hsm tests and test vector list.

jen: ack. Draft attestation doc: https://docs.redwood/security/attestations/2026-hsm — will add evidence IDs after raj’s ingest PR is merged.

sam: ack. Runbook link added to the PR and left a comment for storage.

maria: Thanks all. If any critical blocker surfaces, escalate in this thread and tag me. :thumbsup:
